question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

The laptop that I bought last week works __very good__.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. **'****very well'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in Part **(****very good****)** of the sentence.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence we have to **modify the verb 'works,'** and **an adverb modifies a verb.**
 
• Here** 'good' is not an adverb** but an adjective that can modify a noun.
 
• So we need to **replace 'good' with 'well' which is an adverb.**
 
• Therefore, the use of 'very good' in the sentence should be replaced with **'****very well****'** to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence:__ *The laptop that I bought last week works **__very well__.***
